title: MultiblockCore: Core Loop
summary: Read the blueprint, place the structure, validate it, then upgrade deliberately.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Discover a blueprint, place the structure, validate missing blocks, complete the multiblock, then install upgrades that match the job.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each validation pass, check the exact missing block, orientation, controller, input, output, or upgrade slot before rebuilding.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop when the structure is stable and documented. Future you will thank a clear footprint more than a rushed upgrade.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
